name: Yuka Kouri
bio: Yuka Kouri (向里 祐香, Kōri Yūka, September 24, 1990) is a Japanese actress from Tokyo who is affiliated with office MUGI. Her old stage name is 向里 憂香 (same reading). Previously, she was affiliated with Stardust Promotion and Anore.
